integrity: The proof computes every irreducible-character kernel and codegree from the standard extraspecial character structure, checks the degree-squared identity, and explicitly reconstructs the prime and rank from the pseudo-algebra. A standalone checker verifies representative parameters and the smallest type collisions.
scientific_limitations: The order-recovery statement is internal to the extraspecial family.
The standard extraspecial character table is prior knowledge; the contribution is its exact pseudo-algebra consequence and rigidity/type-blindness classification.
Collisions with non-extraspecial groups are not excluded.
title: Extraspecial group pseudo-algebras recover order but not type
